note: *as equidades*: the stylist heard it as technical and draft 2 took the singular, undone at the Latinist's major on the number. The blind reader did not know the word. *as coisas justas* is option 3 (*justo* is *justus*'s).

*fixaram os seus olhos para se inclinarem à terra*: the Latinist's own fix to a major; on draft 3 he marked it minor and asked back almost the wording he had first rejected. Held (D24: the gate is inconsistent).
*a vossa espada dos inimigos da vossa mão*, the stylist's worst line: his shorter colon drops the articles and *erípere*'s verb, so it was refused. The sword's sense is as open as the Latin's.

*foi enchido*: the Latinist's words, taken after two minors and a major against *se encheu*, which the translator held is how Portuguese says it. HANDOFF: no stylist has read it; *se encheu* is option 2.
